intro: 本次增量新增 15 条产品更新：M365 Copilot 10 条、Copilot Studio / Power Platform 0 条、Azure AI 5 条。

sections.title: M365 Copilot
points: 📌 本次新增 10 条：『Teams： Express face enrollment（November CY2026）』、『Purview： Data Lifecycle Management-Legacy Teams retention policies covering Copilot will be treated as Teams-only（October CY2026）』、『Edge： Autolaunch opt-in experience for managed devices（November CY2026）』、『Planner: Expiration of plans from meetings due to inactivity（October CY2026）』、『Copilot (Microsoft 365)： Copilot Cowork for Government Clouds（November CY2026）』。
🤖 重点关注 Copilot、agent、Teams/Edge/Viva 工作流入口与管理治理。
🔐 建议结合 Agent 365、权限、数据治理和采用运营更新客户材料。

sections.title: Copilot Studio
points: 🧰 重点关注 maker 体验、agent 工具化、MCP、工作流和 Power Platform 与业务流程结合。
🏗️ 适合纳入 CoE、平台治理、低代码生产化与 agent 生命周期材料。

sections.title: Azure AI（Microsoft Foundry）
points: 📌 本次新增 5 条：『A2A Endpoints and A2A Tool in Microsoft Foundry agents』、『[In preview] Public Preview: Foundry Routines in Foundry Agent Service』、『[Launched] Generally Available: Publishing Microsoft Foundry agents to Microsoft 365 Copilot and Teams』、『[In preview] Public Preview: Network egress controls for hosted agents in Microsoft Foundry』、『[Launched] Generally Available: Enable and disable controls for Microsoft Foundry agents in Agent 365』。
🧠 重点关注 Foundry 模型、实时语音、私网部署、评估与生产级 agent 架构。
🚀 可用于 Azure AI Foundry 选型、RAG/agent 成本治理和上线评审。
